Originally posted to Flickr by Calmuziclover and confirmed CC BY 2.0 by FlickreviewR 2; photographed 2020-08-11 (the Pier itself, and this restaurant, opened in 2020, so the photo shows it essentially as built). Diners are incidental, candid and not individually identifiable.
